artistStatement: The Elements of the Universe is a harmonious dance. Each form turns with a distinct rhythm, yet together they move as one - a living meditation on balance and interconnection.
The Elements of the Universe is a harmonious dance. Each form turns with a distinct rhythm, yet together they move as one - a living meditation on balance and interconnection.
The Garden of Ginger’s layered petals seem to grow from the earth itself spiraling skyward with fluid motion as if the garden is in perpetual bloom.
